name: agent-sandbox-image-tag-provenance

controlConfigInputs.name: Floating image tags
controlConfigInputs.description: Additional mutable image tags (e.g. dev, nightly) that should be rejected alongside :latest and untagged images. Default is empty (opt-in).

description: Checks that container images in Agent Sandbox SandboxTemplate resources use an explicit non-latest tag or digest reference, rejecting mutable :latest, untagged images, and any tags listed in floatingImageTags.
remediation: Pin container images to an explicit version tag (e.g. :1.2.3) or a digest reference (e.g. @sha256:...) instead of using :latest, omitting the tag, or using a configured floating tag.
